items.text: Firstly, thank you to everyone who took the time to play the BrokenLore: DON'T LIE demo during Steam Next Fest.
Every download, wishlist, stream, comment and piece of feedback helps the team as we continue towards launch, and we've enjoyed seeing your reactions to the opening moments of Junko's story.
Since the demo went live, we've been listening closely to your feedback and continuing work on optimisation and improvements to deliver the best possible experience at launch.
We're also excited to share that during development we've expanded BrokenLore: DON'T LIE even further.

The team has been working on a brand new chapter for the game. It wasn't something originally planned or envisioned when development began, but as the story evolved, it became something we felt we had to bring to players. We're incredibly excited about what it adds to the experience and look forward to revealing more very soon.
The extra content hasn't changed our plans for launch, and BrokenLore: DON'T LIE remains on track for release on September 10th, 2026.
We're hugely excited for what's ahead and can't wait to share more with you over the coming months.For now, enjoy this brand new clip from the game.
